```sql
WITH barnes_geometry AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Barnes' AND addr_state ILIKE 'Kansas'
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM barnes_geometry)),
      1,
      '32BF'
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM barnes_geometry))
)
SELECT
  MIN(value) AS lowest_slope
FROM (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(slope_rast)).*
  FROM slope_raster
) AS dumps;
```
